name: Ferrox Industrial Supply Co.
about: Ferrox Industrial Supply Co. is a trusted supplier of industrial materials and components, serving plants, workshops and projects across Pakistan since 2009. From bulk chemicals and protective coatings to precision fasteners, stainless steel and lab instruments, we keep production lines running with certified materials, honest lead times and technical support that answers the phone.
story: Ferrox began in 2009 as a two-person trading desk supplying solvents and paints to textile mills in Punjab. Our founders had spent years on the procurement side and knew exactly where supply chains break: unclear specs, inconsistent batches and vendors who disappear after the first invoice.

So we built the company around the opposite habits — documented grades for every chemical, traceable batches, photographs before dispatch, and pricing that holds for the agreed quarter. Word travelled. Today Ferrox supplies more than 400 clients across textiles, food, pharma, construction, power and water utilities, with a 1,500+ line catalog and same-week dispatch from our Islamabad warehouse.
We remain deliberately boring in the best way: we answer quickly, we deliver what the purchase order says, and when something goes wrong we fix it before it becomes your problem.
mission: To make industrial procurement effortless — certified materials, transparent pricing and dependable delivery, so our clients never lose a day of production to a supply problem.
vision: To be the most trusted industrial supply partner in Pakistan, known for the same reliability at item number 1,500 as we were at item number one.
